note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor, after the user-namespace conversion): every tagged unit now opens with `if !userns.Enter(t) { return }`, which re-executes the test in its own user, network and mount namespace and carries the child's fail or skip to the parent (Enter, internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go), and the file builds under plain linux instead of integration && linux. RFC 9568 Section 6.4.2 says "MUST discard packets with a destination link-layer MAC address equal to the Virtual Router MAC address." TestVRRPBackupDoesNotForwardVirtualMACFrames is otherwise unchanged: with the recipe in force and no filter a datagram sent to the virtual MAC is forwarded (control), with setBackupFilter the same datagram is not forwarded, each asserted from a capture on the next hop. TestBackupDiscardFollowsTheState (unchanged) still proves the worker sets and withdraws the discard with the state. Verdict enforced.
